name: Canadian Prairie Championship 2024
information:
## Calling all Prairie cubers!
This is the first ever Prairie Championship, bringing together cubers from Alberta, Saskatchewan and Manitoba. This competition will feature nearly all events over the course of two days.
**Please Note:** the title of "Prairie Champion" will be available for competitors currently residing within one of the prairie provinces at the time of the competition.


### Notice of Filming and Photography
Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.
